text:
maria_rl: quick preflight for EU midnight change window — 00:30–02:00 UTC. final checklist: handoff, canary pin, rollback playbook, release notes, freeze exemptions. pls ack.

ajay: acked. handoff to noah_oncall at 00:15 UTC. I pinned traffic rules in staging. :white_check_mark:

noah_oncall: ack. I'll monitor latency + 5xx. alert thresholds set: errors > 1% OR p95 > 450ms -> escalate.

katie: release notes posted here: https://internal.docs/release/3.4.2-eu. contains known degradations + mitigations. :memo:

product_ops: we approved a temporary embeddings throughput exemption for partner-calls route until 03:30 UTC. documented in notes.

maria_rl: calling out canary pin — we're pinning to v3.4.2-rc3 for this window. keep canary at 10% for first 20m, then 50% for next 20m if healthy.

ajay: pin command I ran: ```sh
redwoodctl deploy pin --route partner-calls --version v3.4.2-rc3 --percent 10 --note "EU midnight canary"
```

deploy-bot: Canary pin applied to partner-calls: v3.4.2-rc3 @10%. Dry-run completed, no config conflicts. Scheduled ramp steps: 10% -> 50% @00:50 UTC.

noah_oncall: quick reminder: rollback trigger is any new 5xx spike > 1% sustained for 3m OR token cost spike > 2x baseline. If triggered, run the one-line rollback:
```sh
redwoodctl rollback --route partner-calls --to-version v3.4.1 --reason "auto-rollback: error spike" --skip-confirm
```

katie: added smoke tests to CI that will run post-ramp; will push pass/fail to #eng-releases-bot.

product_ops: FYI finance was looped — we accepted transient cost variance for exemption window.

ajay: leaving a quick canary checklist snippet in thread so oncall has it: 1) verify canary pin applied 2) watch p95/p50/5xx 3) check deploy-bot logs for ramp steps 4) hold if anomalies 5) rollback if triggers met.

maria_rl: all right — last call for freeze exemptions? this thread is the official decision log. no other objections -> go. :thumbsup:

noah_oncall: go from me. I'll be on pager from 00:00–03:45 UTC.

deploy-bot: Change window started at 00:30 UTC. Canary at 10% active. Next ramp scheduled at 00:50 UTC. Logs: https://deploy.logs/2532100000

maria_rl: thanks team — I'll update the launch board and close the preflight. leaving notes for post-mortem if anything deviates.

noah_oncall: if I need to abort, I'll post "abort: immediate rollback" and run the rollback command above.

ajay: :rocket: good luck everyone.
